geom_reference_point: T_origin (main-body geometric center; CoM recorded separately via features.com_offset_mm)

features.com_note: self-defined; shifted +X toward denser adapter/propulsion end; recorded separately from T_origin per SSOT sec4; low confidence, never measured

grasp_points_mm.name: launch_adapter_ring
grasp_points_mm.note: far +X face rim of Agena-like adapter cylinder; servicer approaches along -X_T into ring; rigid structural capture interface

grasp_points_mm.name: solar_panel_yoke_+Y
grasp_points_mm.note: panel hinge/yoke root fitting at +Y body face; grasp the structural yoke only, NEVER the panel laminate

marker_points_mm.name: AprilTag_front
marker_points_mm.note: servicer-facing +X body face, corner clear of adapter cylinder footprint (radial 127mm > cyl radius 100mm); visible along approach axis

marker_points_mm.name: AprilTag_top
marker_points_mm.note: redundant marker on +Z top face, offset from antenna root

tumble_axis.note: failed non-cooperative satellite assumed slowly tumbling; axis/rate are placeholders to be set by Stage 2 scenario matrix; never measured

frame_axes.+X_T: long body axis toward primary grasp interface / servicer approach direction
frame_axes.+Z_T: toward solar-panel deploy normal / upper surface

assumptions: Mapping: target_satellite_v0 = Target-1 failed non-cooperative small satellite per cad_asset_mapping_v0 sec3 and target_models_requirements sec3; open assets inform GEOMETRY ONLY, geometry re-authored (no BIRDS/OreSat copy).

Frame T per coordinate_frame_definition_v0 SSOT: right-handed; origin at main-body geometric center; +X_T toward primary grasp interface / servicer approach; +Z_T toward panel-deploy normal; +Y_T completes RH. CoM differs from origin and is recorded separately (features.com_offset_mm).

Chose 12U class over 6U for v0; body simplified to a 340 x 226 x 226 mm box (long axis along X_T) from the CDS 12U envelope. These are v0 PLACEHOLDERS, not verified Appendix B dimensions (12U outer dims flagged manual_review_required, APPB-004).

Agena-like cylindrical section modeled as a launch-adapter / separation-ring stub: radius 100mm (~8-inch/203mm sep-ring class), length 120mm, protruding from the +X body face and unioned to it; geometry informed by NASA-3D Agena only, NO inertia inherited.

Solar panels modeled as two deployable flat stub plates (300 x 200 x 12 mm) along +/-Y, one plate per side, rooted at the body Y faces (y=+/-213 center so root touches +/-113 face); hinge/yoke abstracted to a point; panels are fragile keepout, not a default grasp target.
Antenna modeled as a single slender monopole rod (radius 6mm, length 200mm) along +Z rooted on the top face; abstracts a VHF/UHF whip; slender keepout, not a grasp target.
Mass self-defined at 22.0 kg (~12U upper-mass class ~2 kg/U plus adapter and panels); NOT measured; deterministic builder sizes an effective uniform density to hit this target. confidence low.
Inertia is self-defined downstream and NEVER claimed as measured (risk RA-003 / R-014); this spec provides geometry + mass target only, no inertia tensor asserted here.
CoM assumed offset +40mm along +X_T toward the denser adapter/propulsion end; low confidence, to be replaced by the mass-inertia CSV after component assignment.

Primary grasp = rigid launch-adapter ring at the far +X face of the adapter cylinder (approach along +X_T); secondary grasp = solar-panel structural yoke/root at the +/-Y body faces; the panel laminate itself is explicitly forbidden as a grasp surface.

AprilTag markers self-placed on the servicer-facing +X body face (clear of the adapter-cylinder footprint) and on the +Z top face; IDs and 60mm size are placeholders; markers denote demonstration/perception NARRATIVE only, no completed perception claimed.
Non-cooperative failed satellite assumed slowly tumbling; nominal tumble axis self-defined about +Z_T at ~2-5 deg/s placeholder rate, to be finalized by the Stage 2 scenario matrix; low confidence.

Block model only: boxes + cylinders unioned, all primitives mutually touching/overlapping for a single solid; NO fillets, holes, thin-wall, or mechanism detail; grasp/marker/keepout/tumble entries are annotation metadata, not solid geometry.
All dimensions in millimeters; center_offset_mm is measured from the frame T origin.
